newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Q1 chemical exports rise 5.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Q1 chemical exports rise 5.6 pct.

text.p: Exports from Swiss chemical companies in the first quarter of 1997 rose 5.6 percent from last year to 7.0 billion Swiss francs, the Swiss Society of Chemical Industries (SSIC) said.
SSIC also said in a statement that chemical imports into Switzerland rose 11.5 percent to 3.8 billion francs for an export surplus of 3.3 billion, steady from the same period in 1996.
In the first quarter of 1996 exports had risen 5.8 percent and imports 9.4 percent from the previous year.
Exports to Europe rose 8.6 percent with exports to the European Union (EU) up 8.7 percent compared with 3.8 percent in the first quarter of 1996.
Exports to the United States eased considerably in the first quarter for a growht rate of 7.7 percent compared with a rise of 23.8 percent last year.
But exports to Latin America, however, rose by 2.5 percent compared with a drop of 2.0 percent last year.
